Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `5cb6e6e0a`, which carries PR #24681 `12d14765c`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/apply.ts`. It boots with `deferSchemaDdl: true` (about `:213`–`:216`) and creates the tables at `stack.flushSchemaDdl()` (about `:632`). Nothing records the organization-ownership birth after that flush.
- `packages/runtime/src/organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts`, which holds `recordOrganizationOwnershipBirth` / `ledgerStoreCreatedFromEmpty` and the `OrganizationOwnershipBirthMarkerPlugin` docblock (about `:369`–`:373`), only as far as the birth half needs a seam a post-flush caller can use. Also `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts` (about `:1153`) and `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts`, read for the deferred-DDL path.
- The shape: a datastore that was empty before `os migrate apply` gets the birth marker once its tables exist, so the next `os serve` admits it, as PR #24681's body promised. A datastore that was not empty before the apply (a 17.x or 18.0 pre-release database) **never** gets a birth marker from it, and stays refused with the ceremony's text.
- A changeset for every published package touched.
- ⛔ Hold-offs: the guard's refusal rule and text, the ceremony (`os migrate organization-ownership`), `os dev`'s recover branch and its "v17 shape" text (#24833's), `[schema-drift]` lines (#24638's), `packages/drivers/**`, and `packages/spec/**`.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` for the build (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate"). The review of record for the declaration below is run at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by this seat's choice (reason: the birth marker decides the boot guard's admission, and PR #24681's own review failed once on a birth-marker path, `6279650792`).
Clause-②: yes
Basis for the Clause-② line: `os serve` will admit a database that `os migrate apply` created from empty, which it refuses today. That widens the boot guard's admission set by one writer. The guard's rule and its refusal are unchanged, and no published schema or export moves. The review of record judges that no database the guard should refuse can gain a marker.
Responsibility: this lane's CLI door (`packages/cli` `migrate apply`) skips the birth half the runtime offers (`packages/runtime`). No platform path covers it: the guard reads the ledger, and the ledger has no row. It is reachable by any deploy script that runs `os migrate apply` before `os serve`, and it was measured twice on an empty SQLite file (card).
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `migrate/apply.ts`, `organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts`, `standalone-stack.ts` or `schema-migrate.ts`. All 14 open PRs were read in this act. The epic lane's PR #24845 (#24583) touches `serve.ts` and `migrate/duplicates.ts`, which are disjoint.
- This seat's other cards in flight, #24738 (PR #24806, CORS) and #24813 (`domains/packages.ts`), are disjoint.
- #24833 (same line, `os dev`'s recover text) stays queued behind this card. Its text follows whatever this card makes true.
- The open `pm:on-hold` cards' `Restart-touch:` lines (1 line, `scripts/test-shard-timings.json`) have no hit.
- The epic seat (`epic:#15194`, `os-steve`) gets a cross-lane note in this act.

Reproduces on the published 18.0.0 (npm) · QA-source: #24908 · smoke:npm-18.0.0 · B1

Measured at 2026-10-20T13:55Z on a blank create-objectstack@18.0.0 scaffold, installed from npm outside the repo, on a fresh SQLite file. OS_AUTH_SECRET and OS_SECRET_KEY were set.

    npx os build                                   # exit 0
    OS_DATABASE_URL=file:/tmp/x/prod.db npx os migrate apply --yes      # exit 0; sys_migration: 0 rows
    OS_DATABASE_URL=file:/tmp/x/prod.db npx os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json --port 3101
    # exit 1: "This database carries no organization-ownership marker: 17.x or an 18.0 pre-release (18.0.0-next.*) created it ..."

Two workarounds, each measured end to end on the published package (server ready, first-account sign-up 200, sign-in 200, record create/list 200, second sign-up 403). Paste-ready for the release notes:

1. Already ran migrate apply first and got refused: run the ceremony once. On an empty database it changes no rows.

       npx os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json
       npx os migrate organization-ownership --apply --plan-file plan.json --backup-taken
       npx os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json

   Plan exit 0 ("76 table(s) planned"), apply exit 0 ("The ceremony is complete; recorded as adr-0131-organization-ownership"), start: "Server is ready".

2. Fresh install: start the server once before the first migrate apply. That boot writes the birth marker; after it, migrate apply and the next start behave.

       npx os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json     # first boot on the empty DB, then stop it
       npx os migrate apply --yes                          # exit 0, "already in sync"
       npx os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json     # "Server is ready"

Also seen: the refusal is printed three times, twice with a full stack trace, before the one-line summary.
